entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic horror plane under the Eternal Night, stalked by zombies, werewolves and vampires.

entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: The perpetual night threatening humanity, which humans hope to ward off with rituals and a Harvesttide festival.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who is the bride at the biggest vampire wedding in Innistrad history and aims to pact with the Markovs to control Innistrad.

entities.name: Markov bloodline
entities.description: A vampire bloodline bonded with the Voldarens in the wedding.

entities.name: Voldaren bloodline
entities.description: A vampire bloodline of Olivia Voldaren that bonds with the Markovs.

entities.name: Sorin the Mirthless
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker of the Markov bloodline depicted in the set.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Eternally undead beings with calculating, grand designs who feed through Blood tokens.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A character featured in a Story Spotlight card.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: A character featured in a Story Spotlight card.

entities.name: Heron
entities.description: A power whose blood the wedding vow invokes to make the pledge so.

events.summary: Humanity turns to the hope of rituals and a Harvesttide festival to save them from the Eternal Night.
events.quote: As humanity turned to the hope of rituals and a Harvesttide festival to save them from the Eternal Night in Midnight Hunt

events.summary: The biggest vampire wedding in Innistrad history unites the Markov and Voldaren bloodlines.
events.quote: This set features the biggest vampire wedding in Innistrad history

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren, the bride, aims to form a pact with the Markovs to take control over Innistrad.
events.quote: aims to form a pact with the Markovs to take control over Innistrad
